claims.title: Product-end timing: exact pulse optimum and separate chemical stocks

quoted_fields.interface: Introduced constant first-addition hazard a and subsequent unwanted-addition hazard u during a single fixed rectangular pulse. Stages are independent and identical only for stated twenty-stage products. No retries, active rejection, geometry/sequence distribution or sidegroup authentication is included.
quoted_fields.failure: The exact optimum applies only to the specified one-pulse protocol, not every molecular synthesis or the producer multipulse shared-reactor ODE. Assigning selective rates does not construct protection or clearing. Source-reported McTernan2020 differs from held Lewandowski2013. Full covalent handover, authentic whole-sequence output, register renewal, chemistry and cost advantage remain open.
